title: Direct reduction of iron for steelmaking

inventory.name: HYBRIT hydrogen direct-reduction pilot and trial steel
inventory.claim: SSAB rolled trial steel in July 2021 at Oxelösund, reported using hydrogen-reduced iron from the Luleå pilot and announced trial delivery to Volvo Group by 18 August. By August 2024 HYBRIT reported more than 5,000 tonnes of cumulative pilot sponge iron production.
inventory.limit: The pilot total spans campaigns. It gives no annual commercial capacity. The trial shipment gives no sustained commercial supply or later operating status. The specific iron lot’s provenance is an SSAB claim awaiting independent confirmation.

inventory.name: Nu-Iron natural-gas direct-reduction plant
inventory.claim: Nu-Iron began producing commercial direct-reduced iron after the relocated, expanded MIDREX plant started in December 2006. The technology supplier reported plant-specific output quality for 2025. Nucor still listed Nu-Iron as a producer for its mills for the quarter ended 3 October 2026.
inventory.limit: The 1.6 million tonnes per year design rating is distinct from measured output. The quarterly filing gives no site-specific tonnage, uptime or daily November operating status.

inventory.name: LKAB HYBRIT industrial demonstrator
inventory.claim: The environmental court granted a permit covering LKAB’s planned hydrogen-based direct-reduction demonstrator. LKAB and other stakeholders appealed in July. In its October report LKAB said the permit was still before the next court. LKAB also reported in April that it and CINEA had agreed to withdraw from a €113 million EU Innovation Fund grant without disbursement.
inventory.limit: Tenova’s 2024 agreement covered basic engineering. The dated project and court evidence leaves final appeal disposition, final investment decision, commissioning and production open.

trace: monterrey-hyl-batch-direct-reduction: Hylsa needed quality iron for electric-arc steelmaking. The Monterrey batch gas process started industrial production in 1957, independently corroborated by EPA’s first Monterrey row.

monterrey-hyl-zero-reformer: HYL moved through a continuous shaft-furnace generation before the self-reforming 4M scheme was in industrial operation in Monterrey from April 1998. The supplier’s 2021 evolution timeline places a continuous plant at PTKS, Indonesia, in 1980. The canonical link captures the development across generations; the intermediate model is a future record.

lulea-hybrit-hydrogen-direct-reduction: Vendor ENERGIRON equipment and architecture underpinned the Swedish pilot. The independent EC technical assessment describes natural-gas reference campaigns beginning in 2020 and fossil-free hydrogen direct reduction in 2021. A canonical adapts link joins the two process generations.

oxelosund-hybrit-trial-steel: SSAB names the Luleå iron as the source of the trial steel it rolled in July 2021 and reports delivery by August. The recipient’s October load-carrier demonstration supplies separate use evidence. The proposed material link for the specific July lot remains a candidate.

Gällivare is the intended scale-up of the HYBRIT concept; the equipment supplier explicitly connects its Luleå pilot to Gällivare’s basic engineering in its February 2024 announcement. The plan has no observed production event.
alternatives: MIDREX provides a separate, sustained natural-gas commercial route. Its 2019 technical account documents a Toledo pilot in 1967 and regular operation of the Portland commercial prototype from May 1969 (https://www.midrex.com/direct-from-midrex/technical-articles/it-all-started-in-portland-50-years-ago/). The Nu-Iron case study traces that installation through the American Iron Reduction plant in Convent, Louisiana, which began producing in January 1998. The two histories support use of the same process family; physical transfer is documented for Convent to Point Lisas.

A different hydrogen route also operated in Trinidad and Tobago before HYBRIT. Cliffs and Associates used Lurgi’s Circored process, which reduced fine ores in a fluidized bed using hydrogen (https://www.metso.com/globalassets/portfolio/brochure-circored-4886-01-25-en-met.pdf, p. 3). In December 2001 Cleveland-Cliffs reported about 130,000 tons of briquettes produced and sold that year and decided to idle the plant in a weak market (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/764065/000095015201506292/l91879ae8-k_pdf.pdf, Item 9). The episode does not support a HYBRIT priority claim for hydrogen reduction in general.

screen: Checked existing materials/metallurgy discoveries, leads, and concepts for HYL, ENERGIRON, MIDREX, sponge iron, industrial direct reduction, electric-arc steelmaking and HYBRIT. Older Bessemer, blast-furnace and Linz oxygen steelmaking records cover different processes. SSAB attributes the July steel batch to Luleå pilot material; the specific link awaits independent corroboration. The 2020 reference campaigns and 2024 campaign output belong to the Luleå pilot record. Nu-Iron and Gällivare are inventory sites only in this batch.
coverage: Selected installations and one HYL technology lineage. Research cut-off 17 November 2026. Dates represent source-bounded operations, output or approval events. Recent operator and court materials establish project status only within their stated scope. Product, facility and process priority claims were left unresolved.
